# WMS Quantum Digital Twin 3D Simulator

> Industrial Multi-Tier Cyber-Physical Warehouse Optimization & 3D Digital Twin Simulator with Classiq Quantum Acceleration.

- **Legal Owner / Publisher**: YesAndNo Group

## Overview
The WMS Quantum Digital Twin 3D Simulator is an industrial logistics optimization platform created by **YesAndNo Group**. It couples a real-time Three.js cyber-physical warehouse digital twin with Classiq quantum synthesis and hybrid classical-quantum solvers (QAOA and VQE) to solve complex Vehicle Routing Problems (VRP), Capacity-Constrained VRP (CVRP), and dynamic intra-facility dispatching.

## Key Capabilities
1. **Interactive 3D Digital Twin**: Multi-tier warehouse floor with automated guided vehicles (AGVs), dynamic congestion zones, charging bays, and real-time path telemetry.
2. **Quantum Routing Acceleration**: Formulates vehicle routing constraints as Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) models, synthesizing optimal quantum circuits using the Classiq Python SDK and native Qmod.
3. **Hardware-Aware Quantum Synthesis**: Evaluates circuit width, two-qubit gate depth, and transpilation fidelity across quantum hardware backends (IBM Quantum Eagle/Heron, IonQ Forte, Rigetti Aspen).
4. **Real-Time Telemetry & REST API**: Full FastAPI / SQLite engine running in dual-mode (mock streaming for browser deployments and live bidirectional RPC with local Python compute kernels).
5. **Analytics & Diagnostics**: Built-in Google Analytics 4 telemetry, execution comparison, energy landscape plots, and PDF engineering report generation.

## Technical Stack
- **Quantum Platform**: Classiq Engine & Qmod
- **Frontend & 3D Visualization**: React 18, TypeScript, Three.js, Canvas HUD, Vite
- **Backend & Database**: Python 3.11, FastAPI, Uvicorn, SQLite3, NetworkX, NumPy, SciPy
- **Hosting & Infrastructure**: Firebase Hosting (Google Cloud Platform)
